title: If the singular ideal generates the unit ideal of Lambda, A -> Lambda factors through a smooth algebra
statement: Let $R\to A\to\Lambda$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings with $A$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation ($A\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$), and let $H_{A/R}\subset A$ be the singular ideal of $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. If $H_{A/R}\Lambda=\Lambda$ (the ideal of $\Lambda$ generated by the image of $H_{A/R}$ is the unit ideal), then there are a smooth $R$-algebra $B$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $A\to B\to\Lambda$ whose composite is the given map $A\to\Lambda$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07EU (lemma-final-solve), Section 07C4; the proof there takes B = A[x_1,...,x_r]/(f_1x_1+...+f_rx_r-1) for f_i in H_{A/R}, lambda_i in Lambda with sum f_i lambda_i = 1, and leaves the smoothness check ('Details omitted')
